name: – Before § 1 – Am 11
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text: –1a. Agrees with the positions expressed by the Governments of Brazil, Mexico and Colombia and joins them in requesting that the CNE and the Venezuelan authorities do everything in their power to provide maximum transparency on the election result by publishing all the election records; calls on the Venezuelan authorities to publish all the electoral records as soon as possible, in accordance with the Venezuelan Constitution and electoral law;
